data.narrative:
Precision Neuroscience is a Series C-stage biotech company that has raised $180M to date. Valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 3 public comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers in Biotech & Health, with particular focus on 3 same-stage private companies: Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B), Chai Discovery ($3.8B), and New Limit ($3.1B).

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier to the $180M raised proxy, yielding $306M. Peer-median anchoring uses the 3 same-sector, same-stage comparables, which have a median valuation of $3.8B and a range of $3.1B–$10.3B. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied because the target's revenue is not disclosed. The wide dispersion across private peers ($3.1B–$10.3B) reflects heterogeneity in clinical progress and market opportunity within neuroscience at this stage.

The two applicable methods support a range of $260M to $4.4B, with a median of $2.1B. The stage-progression method anchors the lower bound; peer-median methodology dominates the upper bound. Key uncertainties include the target's clinical development stage relative to named peers, intellectual property strength, and commercialization timeline—factors that explain the peer valuation spread. Precision positioning within that range depends on validation of its neurological applications and competitive differentiation versus Colossal, Chai, and New Limit.
